purpose: Independently confirm the frozen Solar H336 forecast-level ACF lag-pair treatment at H720 without changing its architecture, loss weight, data split, or training budget.
research_question: Does the pre-registered training-only forecast lag-pair consistency objective improve the prediction-connected variable-axis Mamba validation MSE at Solar H720?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory confirmation. Every job has skip_test=true; no test metric may be generated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A pass supports only a two-horizon Solar validation mechanism result. It does not establish cross-dataset generalization, test-set superiority, or a universal AutoCon benefit.
prelaunch_gates: verify the Solar AL SHA-256 and TXT numeric-array contract
retain the H336-selected architecture, loss weight, optimizer, split, and budget unchanged
keep exact seed pairing between term-off and term-on arms
keep skip_test=true and save_predictions=false for every job

phases.name: solar_h720_forecast_pair_off
phases.purpose: Exact H720 control retaining the prediction-connected representation and encoder relation objective, without the forecast-pair term.

phases.name: solar_h720_forecast_pair_on
phases.purpose: Exact H720 treatment adding only the pre-registered training-only signed ACF forecast lag-pair consistency term at weight 0.01.

comparison_contract.primary_contrast: forecast-pair term on versus exact term-off control
comparison_contract.telemetry_gate: The treatment must record positive forecast_lag_pair_loss, forecast_lag_pair_count, and forecast_lag_pair_active_anchor_fraction in every completed seed.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: Validation-only two-horizon Solar mechanism evidence; never a test, baseline-superiority, speed, or universal AutoCon claim.

stopping_rules: Do not modify the pair weight, architecture, seeds, data split, or training budget after launch.
The treatment passes only if it has lower mean validation MSE, wins at least two of three exact seed pairs, and passes the nonzero telemetry gate in every seed.
If this independent H720 replication fails, stop the forecast-pair mechanism and do not tune its weight or release a test evaluation.
